title: Regression tests for byte-order marks in decodeText
prompt: Write a node:test file for decodeText in src/decode-text.mjs. Import it with a relative path. Cover UTF-8 with no mark, UTF-8 with a byte-order mark, UTF-16 little-endian with a mark and UTF-16 big-endian with a mark. Assert the exact decoded string in each case. Use Buffer.from to build the input bytes.
